story.title: Momo dan Bayangan yang Takut Gelap
story.author: BacaYuk Studio
story.moralMessage: Gelap adalah bagian alami dari malam, dan kita dapat merasa tenang dengan mengenali hal-hal baik yang ada di dalamnya.
story.description: Momo membantu Bayang mengenal cahaya bulan, kunang-kunang, dan suara lembut malam agar tidak lagi takut pada gelap.

pages.title: Teman yang Selalu Mengikuti
pages.text: Momo si kelinci punya teman bernama Bayang. Saat Momo melompat, Bayang ikut melompat. Saat Momo menari, Bayang ikut menari.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, a tiny warm-white rabbit with round brown eyes, long ears with peach-pink inner fur, wearing mustard-yellow short overalls and a small teal neckerchief, joyfully hops and dances in a sunny flower meadow while his soft lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow mirrors him on the grass, playful friendship, warm gentle daylight, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, rounded shapes, subtle paper texture, edge-to-edge scene, no text.

pages.title: Matahari Mulai Pulang
pages.text: Sore tiba. Matahari turun perlahan. Bayang menjadi panjang sekali, lalu berbisik, “Momo, sebentar lagi gelap.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, the same tiny warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow short overalls and teal neckerchief, stands in the flower meadow at sunset, looking gently at his very long lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow stretching across the grass, amber sun near the horizon, tender anticipation without fear, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, rounded shapes, subtle paper texture, no text.

pages.title: Bayang Bersembunyi
pages.text: Ketika matahari hilang, Bayang bersembunyi di bawah semak. “Aku takut. Di sini terlalu gelap,” katanya pelan.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, the same warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow overalls and teal neckerchief, kneels beside a round leafy bush at gentle blue twilight, a small soft-edged lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow peeks timidly from beneath the leaves, Momo calm and caring, cozy woodland meadow, child-safe nighttime mood with visible shapes, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Tangan Momo
pages.text: Momo mengulurkan tangan. “Kita melihat malam sedikit demi sedikit, ya. Aku akan menemanimu.” Bayang pun keluar perlahan.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, unchanged warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow short overalls and teal neckerchief, offers one paw beside the bush at blue twilight, the small lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow slowly emerges and reaches toward his paw, trusting expressions and gentle body language, moonlit woodland meadow, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, rounded shapes, no text.

pages.title: Lampu Bulan
pages.text: Di atas pohon, bulan bulat bersinar. Cahayanya membuat jalan tampak lembut. “Malam punya lampu sendiri!” seru Momo.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, the same warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow overalls and teal neckerchief, and his small lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow look up at a large friendly full moon above rounded treetops, a soft silver path of moonlight across the meadow, wonder and reassurance, luminous but gentle night, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Bintang Kecil Berkelip
pages.text: Kunang-kunang muncul dari rerumputan. Kelap-kelip, kelap-kelip! Bayang tersenyum melihat lampu-lampu kecil itu menari.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, unchanged warm-white rabbit wearing mustard-yellow overalls and teal neckerchief, watches glowing golden fireflies rise from tall grass with his lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow friend beside him, the shadow now smiling and reaching toward the tiny lights, enchanted garden meadow at night, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Suara dari Rumput
pages.text: Krik... krik... terdengar suara jangkrik. Daun-daun berbisik, srrr... srrr... “Malam sedang bernyanyi,” kata Momo.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, the same warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow overalls and teal neckerchief, and his lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow sit listening in a moonlit patch of grass, a tiny friendly cricket on a leaf and gently swaying foliage create a calm nighttime concert, both characters attentive and relaxed, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Mata yang Terbiasa
pages.text: Momo dan Bayang duduk diam. Perlahan, mereka dapat melihat batu, bunga, dan pohon. Semuanya masih ada di tempatnya.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, unchanged warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow overalls and teal neckerchief, sits peacefully beside his lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow as their eyes adjust to the night, familiar rounded stones, pale flowers, grass and trees becoming clearly visible under moonlight, discovery and calm, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Dunia Beristirahat
pages.text: Burung tidur di sarang. Bunga menutup kelopaknya. Tupai meringkuk di lubang pohon. Dunia rupanya sedang beristirahat.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, the same warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow overalls and teal neckerchief, and his lavender-gray shadow quietly observe a cozy nighttime woodland: birds sleeping in a nest, flowers closing their petals, and a little squirrel curled inside a tree hollow, peaceful resting world, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Berani Satu Lompatan
pages.text: “Aku mau mencoba,” kata Bayang. Ia melompat melewati sepetak jalan yang gelap. Momo melompat bersamanya. Hop!
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, unchanged warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow short overalls and teal neckerchief, leaps together with his lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow across a small darker patch of a moonlit woodland path, both joyful and brave, golden fireflies nearby, gentle dynamic action, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Tidak Sendirian
pages.text: Kini Bayang tahu, gelap tidak berarti sendirian. Ada bulan, kunang-kunang, suara malam, dan Momo di dekatnya.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, the same warm-white rabbit in mustard-yellow overalls and teal neckerchief, walks closely beside his lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow through the calm night meadow, full moon above, fireflies around them and a cricket on a leaf, warm friendship and belonging, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

pages.title: Selamat Malam
pages.text: Di rumah, Momo menarik selimut. Bayang berbaring tenang di samping tempat tidur. “Selamat malam, Momo.” Dunia pun beristirahat.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Momo, unchanged warm-white rabbit wearing mustard-yellow short overalls and teal neckerchief, tucked into a small wooden bed beneath a patchwork blanket, his lavender-gray rabbit-shaped shadow resting peacefully on the floor beside the bed, moon and a few fireflies visible through a round window, cozy safe bedtime, soft hand-painted 2D children's picture-book illustration, no text.

quizQuestion.question: Apa yang membuat Bayang lebih tenang saat malam?
options: Mengenal cahaya dan suara malam bersama Momo
quizQuestion.explanation: Bayang menjadi tenang setelah mengenal bulan, kunang-kunang, dan suara malam bersama Momo.

continuityRules: Gunakan desain, proporsi, pakaian, dan warna pada character bible tanpa perubahan.
Momo selalu memakai overall kuning mustard dan saputangan hijau teal tanpa sepatu.
Bayang selalu berupa siluet kelinci abu-abu lavender yang ramah, bukan hantu dan bukan kelinci berbulu kedua.
Gunakan malam berwarna biru-indigo yang lembut; jangan membuat adegan terlalu gelap untuk anak usia 3-5 tahun.
Pertahankan gaya lukisan 2D lembut, bentuk membulat, tekstur kertas halus, dan palet yang tidak terlalu jenuh.
Jangan memasukkan tulisan, huruf, angka, balon percakapan, logo, atau watermark ke dalam ilustrasi.
